primitives.name: Weak Form Market Efficiency

primitives.name: Semi-Strong Form Efficiency
primitives.verbatim_quote: The semi-strong efficiency for betting markets implies that the expected returns on any bet or type of bet, placed about different events with identical probabilities of success, should be identical [Williams 1999].
